tools.title: GrokToolsConfiguration
tools.description:
Typed xAI tools supported by this app's convenience configuration.

Every tool is disabled in the default configuration: the searches must
be switched on via their ``enabled`` flags and ``mcp_servers`` starts
empty. ``file_search`` / collections are intentionally absent and
unsupported due to Zero Data Retention (ZDR) requirements. Caller-side
function tools are likewise absent from the typed configuration — they
require a client that answers callback events over /realtime, so they
remain available only to raw ``session.update`` passthrough clients.
Raw realtime passthrough stays generic except that ZDR-incompatible
tool declarations are rejected in-band.

audio_url.title: Audio URL
audio_url.description: URL of the audio containing the user's speech. The Grok agent listens to it and replies with speech. Most common audio formats are supported; the audio is converted to 16-bit 24 kHz mono PCM before being sent to Grok. Maximum duration 10 minutes, maximum file size 50 MB.
